acceptance_runs.name: lateral_1p2m_no_reverse
acceptance_runs.failure_reason: looped without converging: goal is 1.2 m away laterally but the minimum turning radius is 1.669 m and reversing plus rotate-to-heading are disabled, so the vehicle circles instead of reaching the tolerance

fixes_this_round.bug: scene mirrored about the map x-axis
fixes_this_round.detail: wall meshes and collision boxes used world y = origin.y + row*res; ROS map row 0 is the highest y so the correct form is origin.y + (rows - row)*res
fixes_this_round.symptom: vehicle spawned inside a phantom wall, cmd_vel produced wheel spin but no motion, ground truth frozen at z=1.20 when released from height
fixes_this_round.verified: wall boxes intersecting the spawn footprint: 2 before, 0 after; drop test settles at z=0.1569/0.1625/0.1650 from release heights 1.20/0.40/0.165

fixes_this_round.bug: single-plane gpu_lidar collapsed to all-0.1 m ranges through ros_gz_bridge
fixes_this_round.detail: with vertical samples < 3 the gz vertical_angle_step is nan and the bridge emits the minimum range for every beam
fixes_this_round.fix: vertical samples 3 spanning -0.017..0.017 rad; scan height 0.62 m above the lidar housing

fixes_this_round.bug: stack children died with the launching shell
fixes_this_round.detail: background jobs received SIGHUP when the WSL command returned
fixes_this_round.fix: setsid nohup for gz, bridge, truth and nav2 in run_lab_stack.bash, and stale *.log removed before the readiness grep

known_limitations: no reversing and no rotate-to-heading: laterally placed goals inside the 1.669 m turning radius are unreachable by design
wall height 2.4 m is an assumption; unknown cells generate no geometry but the floor is an infinite plane
ground truth is a plugin in the same world, so it is not an independent measurement source
process_cleanup: stack stopped through stop_lab_stack.bash plus pattern kill; verified 0 remaining sim processes

collision_source_correction.issue: the Gazebo Contact system is loaded (confirmed with a verbose run) but no /world/hz_lab_2d/contacts topic is ever advertised in this build, so the bridged /contacts topic carried nothing
collision_source_correction.consequence: every '0 collisions' figure recorded from that topic means 'not measured', not 'no contact happened'

retrospective_check.what: footprint edge clearance against the occupancy grid, over the truth poses stored during each run (track_collision_audit.json)
retrospective_check.limits: samples the recorded poses only; a brief contact between samples is invisible, and pushing against a wall without footprint overlap is not a contact in this test

collision_source_correction.replacement_source: a blocked detector: wheel odometry advancing while the simulated pose does not.  Validated by driving into a wall on purpose (rl_termination_test.json: collision reported after 1.1 m of a 1.6 m approach)
collision_source_correction.action_taken: the evaluator and the RL environment now report contact_proxy with contact_source, and no longer present an empty topic as a clean run
